newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Albanian rebels have cool reaction to Berisha deal.
newsitem.headline: Albanian rebels have cool reaction to Berisha deal.

text.p: Albanian rebels reacted coolly on Sunday to an agreement between President Sali Berisha and leaders of all political parties for a national unity government and elections by June.

"We are pleased with the statement. We are in touch with (rebels in) Sarande, Vlore and Delvine to decide what to do. But at this point our position remains that Berisha must quit before we surrender our weapons," said ex-general Agim Gozhita, who was elected on Sunday to head this southern town's rebel council.

Berisha cut the deal to try to put an end to a rebellion which has swept Albania's southern region, close to the Greek border, in recent weeks. Gjirokaster fell to rebels on Saturday along with a major army base nearby.
The number two in the Gjirokaster rebel council, Sotirakis Manthos, said: "From what we've heard so far, we won't give our weapons back. We want him (Berisha) to resign."

A third council member, opposition Socialist Party member, Murat Kaci said: "Berisha has a very bad record of keeping his word and we don't believe him. We'll decide what to do when it's proven that what he says is true."
